name: Hokota (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Hokota city emblem in green and blue: a disc of green above and blue below, divided by a white wavy line, with a white ring.
history: Municipal flag of Hokota, a city in Ibaraki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 11 October 2005.

features.role: Hokota city emblem — a disc of green above and blue below, divided by a white wavy line, with a white ring
